dimensions.note: ageKeyName is a file name, never a path or a value: the extension computes a path, stats it and hands it to sops in SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE; it never reads the identity. A caller's exported SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE wins, so no configuration can redirect a person's own key. The standing credentials-sensitive-field warning on secretsDir is a directory name, not a secret, unchanged since 2026.09.20.2.
A vault provider has no logger and this one prints nothing; no path, name or value reaches a log line. Errors carry sops's stderr, which names recipients and locations, never key material.

The schema refuses a name with a path separator, a dot name or a control character, and refuses ageKeyFile and ageKeyName together, before any sops call. A missing file is not an error: the environment is left alone and sops reports its own failure to decrypt, which get rethrows with the exit code and stderr. Only NotFound is swallowed by fileExists; other stat errors propagate.

15 tests, 0 failed: 9 unit tests of sopsAgeDir and sopsEnv with a fake existence check that rejects any path it was not told about (file present, absent, caller's export wins, no home, ageKeyFile verbatim, neither set, bad names, both set); conformance with new valid and invalid configs; two live tests against sops 3.13.3 and age-keygen, one decrypting through a key found by name in a scratch XDG_CONFIG_HOME and one refused when the named file is absent. The test task now passes --allow-run, so the integration tests run instead of being silently ignored, as they were in 2026.09.20.2.

put, list and delete are unchanged. The environment is computed per sops call from the current process environment, so a key file that appears or disappears between runs is honoured on the next call; nothing is cached.

sopsAgeDir mirrors sops's own lookup for keys.txt: XDG_CONFIG_HOME when set, else the user config directory, ~/Library/Application Support on macOS and ~/.config elsewhere. The XDG branch is exercised live against sops 3.13.3; the home branches are unit tested for both operating systems the manifest lists. Windows is not a declared platform.
One stat per sops invocation and no handles, timers or temporary files beyond the existing private directory for encryption, which is still removed on every path.

README documents ageKeyName and ageKeyFile as alternatives with a placeholder name; no addresses, hostnames or identifiers. Manifest version 2026.10.19.1, description updated, license declared; NOTICE records the modification; the review is committed in .review with the release. The deno-command safety warning is the sops subprocess the extension exists to run, argument vector only, unchanged since the first release.
Unchanged: a missing key throws Secret not found before any sops call; a sops failure throws with its stderr, covered by the new live negative test.
Unchanged: put overwrites the key's file; the conformance suite and the per-file live test write the same key twice.
Unchanged: list walks the directory and returns names derived from file paths, decrypting nothing.
Unchanged: the constructor's name is returned.
